healthcareSystem: Excellent healthcare fully integrated with the French system. Princess Grace Hospital Centre is the main facility — modern and well-equipped. Monaco offers world-class medical care.
qualityNotes: World-class healthcare. Princess Grace Hospital Centre is a modern, fully equipped facility with all major specialties. Monaco's healthcare is integrated with France's system — patients can also access hospitals in Nice (20 min away). Many doctors trained at top French and international institutions.
pharmacyHours: Pharmacies open 8:30am-7:30pm weekdays, 9am-12:30pm Saturday. Rotating duty pharmacy (pharmacie de garde) for nights and weekends.
pharmacyTips: Well-stocked pharmacies with the same products available in France. Pharmacists are highly trained and can provide medical advice. Green cross sign indicates pharmacies. Duty pharmacy info available at all pharmacy doors and police stations.
prescriptionRules: Prescription (ordonnance) required for antibiotics and most medications. French prescriptions valid. EU prescriptions generally accepted. Pharmacists can recommend OTC alternatives.

restrictedMeds.name: Cannabis/CBD products
restrictedMeds.note: Illegal in Monaco. Do not bring any cannabis or CBD products.

restrictedMeds.name: Strong opioids
restrictedMeds.note: Carry a prescription and a doctor's letter. French Schengen certificate recommended.

restrictedMeds.name: Benzodiazepines
restrictedMeds.note: Carry prescription. Same regulations as France.

bringDocumentation: Carry prescriptions and a doctor's letter for all medications. Documentation in French is ideal but English is widely understood. For controlled substances, obtain a Schengen certificate if possible. Keep medications in original packaging.

travelInsurance.tips: European Health Insurance Card (EHIC) is NOT valid in Monaco — it is not in the EU/EEA. Healthcare costs are HIGH (premium French pricing). Private travel insurance is strongly recommended.

vaccinations.notes: No special vaccinations needed. Standard European health precautions apply.

waterNotes: Tap water is safe to drink and of excellent quality. Same water supply system as the French Riviera.
foodSafetyTips: Exceptional food safety standards. Monaco has some of the finest restaurants in the world with rigorous hygiene standards. All food establishments are well-regulated.
medicalTourismNote: Monaco attracts high-end medical tourists for specialized procedures, wellness treatments, and cosmetic surgery. Princess Grace Hospital Centre offers premium international patient services.
metaDescription: Health guide for Monaco. Princess Grace Hospital, French pharmacy system, EHIC not valid, premium healthcare costs, and travel insurance tips.

hospitals.name: Centre Hospitalier Princesse Grace (Princess Grace Hospital Centre)
hospitals.notes: Main hospital with full emergency department, all major specialties, and modern equipment. International patient services. Many staff speak English. World-class facility.

pharmacyPhrases.local: J'ai besoin d'un médicament contre le mal de tête
Où est la pharmacie la plus proche?

dentalCare.availability: Excellent dental care with multiple private practices offering premium services.
dentalCare.costRange: $100-400 USD for basic procedures — premium pricing
dentalCare.notes: Top-quality dental care. Many dentists cater to international clientele. Cosmetic dentistry widely available. Prices reflect Monaco's premium positioning.
dentalCare.emergencyTip: Princess Grace Hospital has emergency dental services. Private dentists often available for urgent appointments.

mentalHealth.englishTherapists: Several English-speaking therapists and psychiatrists in private practice. Many international practitioners.
mentalHealth.notes: Good mental health services available for a microstate. Private practitioners predominate. French and English widely spoken in therapeutic settings.

accessibilityInfo.overview: Monaco has been improving accessibility, though the hilly terrain and historic buildings present challenges.
accessibilityInfo.hospitalAccess: Princess Grace Hospital is fully wheelchair accessible with modern facilities.
accessibilityInfo.transport: Public elevators and escalators connect different levels of the city. Buses have accessibility features. The principality's small size helps with navigation.
accessibilityInfo.tips: Monaco's public elevators are a unique accessibility feature connecting steep areas. Major hotels and the Casino area are accessible. Request accessible rooms in advance.

covidStatus.entryRequirements: No COVID testing or vaccination requirements for entry as of 2026.
covidStatus.maskPolicy: No mask mandates. May be requested in healthcare facilities.
covidStatus.testing: Testing available at Princess Grace Hospital and private labs.
covidStatus.notes: Monaco follows similar protocols to France. Standard precautions apply.

insuranceClaimProcess: Princess Grace Hospital accepts major credit cards and can bill international insurers directly for significant procedures. For routine visits, payment is typically expected upfront with reimbursement from your insurer. Obtain detailed receipts (feuille de soins) with diagnosis codes.

commonCosts.note: Costs are at the premium end of French healthcare pricing. EHIC not valid. Quality is excellent. Travel insurance strongly recommended.

medicalEvacuation.note: Evacuation is rarely needed — Princess Grace Hospital handles almost all cases. CHU de Nice is 20 minutes away for additional specialties. Helicopter transfer to major French hospitals is quick and routine.

drugNameMap.note: Widely available. French brands. Ask for 'paracétamol' at the pharmacy.
